customer_message.subject: Request for help contesting termination of my tenancy at Bahnhofstrasse 64, Olten
customer_message.body:
Dear Claims Team,

I am writing to ask for your help in contesting the termination of my tenancy at Bahnhofstrasse 64 in Olten, a 4-room flat rented from Wincasa Nord AG. The flat is our family home. My spouse lives here with me, and we have two children who attend the local school.

The landlord is ending the lease because of rent arrears. The landlord states that we owe about CHF 4920. I believe the amount and the grounds for ending the lease need to be examined properly before anything is accepted.

Moving out by the stated end date would cause us serious hardship. Finding a comparable four-room flat in Olten within a few months is very difficult at the moment, and a sudden move would disrupt the children's schooling in the middle of the school year.

I would therefore like to request an extension of the tenancy so that we have time to find suitable accommodation. Could you please confirm whether my legal expenses cover this dispute and what the next steps would be? I can be reached at this e-mail address or by phone during the day.

Kind regards,
Riley Bennett
